edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 30 Iesu Nave Hom. I 5

source_text: Nec lini stipulam in qua exploratores delitescebant absque sacramentis accipio — linum indumentum sacerdotale; vos gens sancta, regnum sacerdotale. Meretrix inimicitias subit adversus Hierichontium regem — caro adversus spiritum. Rex inimicus — princeps huius mundi — non potest obtinere exploratores quia per montes iter faciunt. Moyses non dixit Stet sol; Iesus: Stet sol super Gabaon et luna super vallem Aelom. Iesus meus solem stare fecit modo in adventu: dum bellum gerimus adversus principatus, sol iustitiae adsistit — Ecce ego vobiscum sum omnibus diebus usque ad consummationem saeculi.
pass_a_gloss: Nor of-flax stalk in which spies were-hiding without sacraments I-accept — flax garment priestly; you nation holy, kingdom priestly. Harlot enmities undergoes against of-Jericho king — flesh against spirit. King enemy — prince of-this world — not can obtain spies because through mountains journey they-make. Moses not said Let-stand sun; Jesus: Let-stand sun over Gibeon and moon over valley Aijalon. Jesus my sun to-stand made now in advent: while war we-wage against principalities, sun of-righteousness stands-by — Behold I with-you am all days until consummation of-age.
pass_b_english: I do not take without mystery the [[flax stalks in which the spies hid >> Bible:Joshua 2:6]] — flax is priestly clothing; [[you are a holy nation, a royal priesthood >> Bible:1 Peter 2:9]]. The harlot enters enmity with Jericho’s king — [[flesh lusts against the spirit >> Bible:Galatians 5:17]]; [[the world hates you >> Bible:John 15:18]]. That hostile king is the [[prince of this world >> Bible:John 12:31]]; he cannot seize Jesus’ spies because they travel the mountains: [[I lift my eyes to the hills; whence comes my help? >> Bible:Psalm 121:1]]. Moses never said [[Let the sun stand >> Bible:Joshua 10:12]]; Jesus did — [[Sun, stand over Gibeon, and moon over the valley of Aijalon >> Bible:Joshua 10:12]] — and Scripture adds that [[God never so listened to a man >> Bible:Joshua 10:14]]. My Jesus still makes the sun stand in his coming: while we [[wrestle against principalities and powers >> Bible:Ephesians 6:12]], the [[sun of righteousness >> Bible:Malachi 4:2]] stays with us — [[Behold, I am with you all days until the end of the age >> Bible:Matthew 28:20]].
